depends_on: Specker-Blatter theorem (MSOL classes over binary relations: labeled counts satisfy linear recurrences mod every M)
notes: Periodicity mod m known: posets are FO-definable with one binary relation, so by Specker-Blatter A001035 is ultimately periodic mod 2m, hence a(n) mod m. Period lengths 2phi(m)/phi(m) open (for primes would follow from A001035(n+p) = A001035(n+1) mod p, unproved). Outside Lean: Specker-Blatter; period-length claim not addressed.
